nodes.summary: The Delannoy numbers $D(m,n)$, for $m, n \in \mathbb{N}$, are defined by $D(0,n) = 1$ and $D(m,0) = 1$ for all $m, n \in \mathbb{N}$, and $D(m+1,n+1) = D(m,n+1) + D(m+1,n) + D(m,n)$ for all $m, n \in \mathbb{N}$.
nodes.title: Delannoy numbers

nodes.summary: Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $p_1, \dots, p_n$ and $q_1, \dots, q_n$ be points of $\mathbb{N}^2$. A family $L = (L_1, \dots, L_n)$, in which $L_i$ is a southeast path from $p_i$ to $q_i$ for each $i$, is nonintersecting when for all $i \ne j$ no point occurs both in $L_i$ and in $L_j$.
nodes.title: Nonintersecting families of southeast paths

nodes.summary: Let $d \in \mathbb{N}$, let $D \subseteq \mathbb{Z}^d$ and let $p, q \in \mathbb{Z}^d$. A lattice path from $p$ to $q$ with step set $D$ is a finite sequence $(v_0, v_1, \dots, v_m)$ of points of $\mathbb{Z}^d$, for some $m \in \mathbb{N}$, such that $v_0 = p$, $v_m = q$, and $v_i - v_{i-1} \in D$ for $1 \le i \le m$.
nodes.title: Lattice paths with prescribed steps

nodes.summary: The Lucas numbers $(L_n)_{n \ge 0}$ are the natural numbers defined by $L_0 = 2$, $L_1 = 1$, and $L_{n+2} = L_{n+1} + L_n$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$.
nodes.title: Lucas number sequence

nodes.summary: The Motzkin numbers $(M_n)_{n \ge 0}$ are the natural numbers defined by $M_0 = 1$ and, for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, $M_{n+1} = M_n + \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} M_k M_{n-1-k}$, where the sum is empty when $n = 0$. Thus $M_0, M_1, M_2, M_3 = 1, 1, 2, 4$.
nodes.title: Motzkin number sequence

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a set and let $n \in \mathbb{N}$. For $n \ge 1$, a word of length $n$ over $A$ is a tuple $(a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{n-1})$ of elements of $A$, and two words $(a_0, \dots, a_{n-1})$ and $(b_0, \dots, b_{n-1})$ are rotationally equivalent if there is an integer $r$ with $0 \le r < n$ such that $b_i = a_{(i+r) \bmod n}$ for $0 \le i < n$. nodes.title: Fixed-length necklaces

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, let $x = (x_j)_{j \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a family of elements of $R$, let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, and let $p = (p_1, \dots, p_n)$ and $q = (q_1, \dots, q_n)$ be tuples of points of $\mathbb{N}^2$. The nonintersecting path weight sum of type $(p, q)$ is $W(p, q) = \sum_L \prod_{i=1}^{n} \operatorname{wt}(L_i)$, the sum taken over all nonintersecting families $L = (L_1, \dots, L_n)$ in…
nodes.title: Weighted sum over nonintersecting path families

nodes.summary: A point of the quarter plane is a pair $(a, b) \in \mathbb{N}^2$, with $a$ the horizontal coordinate and $b$ the height. Let $p$ and $q$ be points of the quarter plane. A southeast path from $p$ to $q$ is a list $v = [v_0, v_1, \dots, v_m]$ of points of the quarter plane, for some $m \in \mathbb{N}$, with $v_0 = p$, $v_m = q$, and, for each $1 \le t \le m$, either $v_t = v_{t-1} + (1, 0)$ (an east step) or…
nodes.title: Southeast paths

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative monoid, written multiplicatively, let $x = (x_j)_{j \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a family of elements of $R$, let $p, q \in \mathbb{N}^2$, and let $v = [v_0, \dots, v_m]$ be a southeast path from $p$ to $q$. nodes.title: Weight of a southeast path

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
